reviews.rationale: The rendered crop visibly shows the B-cell scRNA-seq input, paired text descriptions, and both the cell-to-text and text-to-cell projector/LLM interfaces. It is grounded input evidence, not just a generic architecture panel.

The crop contains the actual input box, tokenization and encoder path, and the downstream task cards that make the route readable. This is enough to ground several actual input routes, including annotation, origin, aging, disease, and mask-prediction tasks.

The crop visibly shows both source inputs, the two text encoders, and the model-facing embedding path into the LLM. That is the smallest coherent evidence for the protein-sequence and functional-description routes.

The crop shows the pathology image, the question prompt, and the immediate verifier/correction loop. That is sufficient grounded input evidence for the VQA path, rather than only a benchmark or generic architecture summary.

The crop visibly includes the DAPI conditioning image and the generated histology outputs from the compared methods. It is a valid minimal qualitative input-to-output example for the DAPI-to-H&E synthesis route.
